 Appearance :

 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Uma Shankar Pd.Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
2 18-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State.

This is an application for quashing of the order dated 27.3.2012 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Hilsa, Nalanda in Trial No. 479/2015 arising out of Complaint Case No. 749(C)/2011 whereby and where under the learned court below took cognizance under Sections 323, 504, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

Issue notice to Opposite Party No. 2 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as Registered Cover with A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks failing which this application shall stand dismissed without further Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.52218 of 2015(2) dt.18-03-2023 reference to the bench.
List this case after appearance of Opposite Party No. 2 and/or Service Report, whichever is earlier.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the petitioner shall file supplementary affidavit bringing on record the present status of the case.
